# DSH Prompt Better
### ✨ One click. A clearer prompt.
Turn a rough idea into a focused prompt—right where you write. Enhance, cancel, or restore without l
eaving your conversation.
**English** · 简体中文
## From rough idea to ready-to-send
Ask a quick question, then enhance it into a clear request with useful context.

BEFORE
AFTER
## A simple three-state button

| ✨ Enhance |  Enhancing · click to cancel | ↺ Restore |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Rewrite your draft in place
. | The animated spinner shows the request is running. | Bring back the original draft at any time a
inner shows the request is running. | Bring back the original draft at any time after enhancement. |
The rewrite keeps your draft's language. Your text stays safe, too: if a request fails or you keep t
yping while it runs, the plugin won't replace it. File-reference chips are preserved.
## Uses your current DSH model
Enhancement follows the model selected for the conversation when you click ✨, using your existing DS
H provider and API setup. **No separate API key or model setup is needed.** If the conversation has
no model selection, the DSH host's default model is used.
